notes: Assembler 2.0 — a fast video editor. Opens clean (both panels folded, video first). Timeline like Premiere: scrub on the ruler, C = split at playhead, click a piece + Delete, Shift-magnet, Alt+wheel zoom, ⤢ big timeline, Cmd-drag audio scrub, Undo / Redo (Cmd+Z / Cmd+Shift+Z). Audio lanes: Clip audio · Music · SFX as layers (mute / volume / move), own audio file, music / voice / stems export. Text panel on the left (Text · Words · Sentences): voices get their own caption style, ✦ accent words and 🎨 own style for a phrase. Style · Titles · Sound on the right. Punctuation Off / ?! only / All — ? and ! now stay by default (older presets too; pick Off for the old look). Style regions → Voices + Body. Repeat moved out of Edit. Export ▾ menu: Video · Audio only · Stems · SRT.
